turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jordan calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Jimmy Cunningham?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Can I also confirm the email we have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, that's still the right one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $1,356.83.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I'm on short-term disability, so my pay is reduced.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My husband is very sick right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm only bringing home about $1580 a month now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
